description: Sword-and-board Shadow tank - blocking and strikes build Insanity, spent through Void Strikes. Twilight Shieldtoss is the engine, hitting harder and healing more the higher your Insanity.
_source_note: Built from CoA handoff doc + confirmed screenshot numbers (Twilight Shieldtoss, Dreadnought shield, Twilight Domain, Horrifying Presence, Sermon of Dread confirmed via screenshot). Real mechanic per handoff: Insanity builds mainly from blocking (Inner Darkness), drains through Void Strikes, and feeds Twilight Shieldtoss's damage/heal scaling plus Void-Enhanced Shield's absorb above 60-80 Insanity.

nodes.name: Strength of the Sha
nodes.description: Increases spell damage scaling from Strength and spell hit from Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 20 Passive. Spell damage from Strength; spell hit from Intellect.'

nodes.name: Thick Skin
nodes.description: Increases Armor and Stamina by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Dreadnought
nodes.description: Reaching 100 Insanity no longer causes Total Madness.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Reaching 100 Insanity no longer causes Total Madness. Teaches Dreadnought.' Removes the class-wide overload risk for the tank spec that naturally sits high on Insanity.

nodes.name: Voidwarding
nodes.description: Increases party and raid damage reduction, and increases your resistances. Does not stack with similar effects.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Party/raid damage reduction (no stacking with similar); boosts your resistances (scales with level).'

nodes.name: Void Reaver
nodes.description: Avoiding or absorbing an attack has a chance to boost your next Blade of the Empire's damage and hit an extra enemy.

nodes.name: Inner Darkness
nodes.description: Blocking generates Insanity.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as this spec's primary Insanity generator: 'Blocking generates Insanity.' The shield is the whole engine here.

nodes.name: Entropic Retaliation
nodes.description: Blocking increases your critical strike chance for a duration, stacking.

nodes.name: Void Resilience
nodes.description: Increases your Shadow resistance by 2% per rank.

nodes.name: Dreadfall
nodes.description: Learn Dreadfall, a shield charge dealing Shadow damage to enemies passed through and generating extra threat.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc, Dreadnought's opener: 'Charge in with Dreadfall...' Real gap-closer/pull tool shared conceptually with Godblade's Dreadfall.

nodes.name: Shadowy Symbiosis
nodes.description: Critical blocks reduce the cooldown of Void Strikes.

nodes.name: Void Strikes
nodes.description: Learn Void Strikes, spending Insanity for a heavy Shadow weapon strike.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Dreadnought's core Insanity spender: 'spends with Void Strikes.'

nodes.name: Deep Secrets
nodes.description: Each point of Insanity you hold reduces the Mana cost of your instant spells and abilities.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 30 Passive. Each Insanity point reduces instant spell/ability mana cost.' This spec's mana-sustain solution.

nodes.name: Void-Enhanced Shield
nodes.description: Above 60-80 Insanity, your block value and absorb effects scale up further.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as Dreadnought's core defensive scaling: 'above 60-80 Insanity, Void-Enhanced Shield's absorb+block value scale up.'

nodes.name: Bulwark of Shadow
nodes.description: Learn Bulwark of Shadow, a defensive cooldown that reduces damage taken for a duration.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: real named defensive cooldown, layered with Eldritch Bastion as the last-ditch mitigation per the playstyle writeup.

nodes.name: Eldritch Bastion
nodes.description: An emergency cooldown that grants a massive shield in a moment of crisis.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as the last-ditch mitigation cooldown, Dreadnought's capstone panic button.

nodes.name: Crushing Dissonance
nodes.description: Learn Crushing Dissonance, interrupting and school-locking all nearby enemy spellcasts.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed as a real AoE interrupt: 'Interrupts + school-locks all nearby enemy casts.' Rare shutdown tool for a bruiser tank.

nodes.name: Armageddon
nodes.description: Learn Armageddon, repeating AoE Shadow damage that heals you and reduces nearby damage taken for you and allies.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Repeating AoE Shadow damage; heals you (% of damage dealt); reduces nearby damage taken (self+allies).' Real sustained-fight tool.

nodes.name: Test of Pride
nodes.description: Learn Test of Pride, taunting a target enemy.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Taunts a target.' Single-target taunt tool alongside Horrifying Presence's AoE version.

nodes.name: Doomcloak
nodes.description: Learn Doomcloak, an absorb shield that reduces Magic damage taken while active.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc: 'Absorb shield; reduces Magic damage taken while active.'

nodes.name: Embodiment of Y'Shaarj
nodes.description: Increases Void Shield's absorb amount. Absorbing damage grants spell power based on the value absorbed.

nodes.name: Strength of the Black Empire
nodes.description: Shed your mortal form into a void monstrosity, reducing damage taken.
nodes._source: CoA handoff doc confirmed: 'Level 40 Passive. Sheds mortal form into a void monstrosity, reducing damage taken.'

nodes.name: Blessing of Y'Shaarj
nodes.description: While transformed into the void monstrosity, increases damage dealt further.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Level 50 Passive. While transformed into void monstrosity, boosts damage dealt further.'

nodes.name: Eldritch Force
nodes.description: Learn Eldritch Force, a frontal wave of Shadow damage that slows enemies hit.
nodes._source: CoA tooltip confirmed: 'Generates 30 Insanity. Frontal wave: Shadow damage + slow.'
